 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. We are hours away from El Clsico, the battle between LAFC and LA Galaxy . It's rare to see a derby this evenly matched in the season. Both teams are battling for a playoff spot, with LAFC holding a six-point advantage, but the Galaxy aren't giving up.
 Moreover, winning a rivalry match adds something special to a season and can often even be a reason for clubs to keep certain players or coaches on their roster.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement With 27 matches played between the two teams, LAFC and LA Galaxy are also tied in their head-to-head record, with 10 wins each and seven draws in the remaining encounters.
 With that being said, join us for this LAFC vs. LA Galaxy preview. In this article, we will discuss the latest news, provide information on how to watch the game, and present the predicted formation.

 When is the kick-off? Sunday, October 25th
 What time is kick-off? 9:00 pm ET
 Where is it played? BMO Stadium, Los Angeles
 Predicted lineups for the Black and Gold vs. the Galaxys
 LAFC:
 Goalkeeper: Hugo Lloris
 Defenders: Ryan Hollingshead, Aaron Long, Nkosi Tafari Burgess, Yevgen Cheberko
 Midfielders: Mark Delgado, Igor Jesus, Leo Walta
 Forwards: Heung-Min Son, Jacob Shaffelburg, Denis Bouanga
 LA Galaxy:
 Goalkeeper: JT Marcinkowski
 Defenders: Harbor Miller, Justin Haak, Carlos Garcs, John Nelson
 Midfielders: Sergi Roberto, Marco Reus, Pablo Ruiz
 Forwards: Robert Taylor, Joo Klauss, Erik Thommy
 Where to watch Los Angeles Football Club vs. LA Galaxy
 LA Galaxy v Los Angeles Football Club | Liza Rosales/ISI Photos/GettyImages
 The encounter between these two teams will start at 9:00 pm ET at BMO Stadium in Los Angeles.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement This match is available to watch live on Apple TV. Remember, all MLS games can only be watched through Apple TV.

 Score Prediction
 Given the current form of both teams, a draw seems like a reasonable prediction. Still, with so much attacking talent on display, either side could grab a decisive goal. In a match this balanced, just one moment of brilliance could tip the scales.
 Ultimately, the outcome may hinge on which team manages to stay disciplined under pressure. With so much at stake in this derby, both sides will prioritize maintaining possession and minimizing risks. In such a tense atmosphere, a single costly error could be the difference between victory and defeat.
